name: Galouti Kebab
description: Hand-minced lamb, rose petal and a spice blend kept in the family for four generations. Melts on the tongue. Served on a saffron ulte tawa paratha.
imageAlt: Kebabs on skewers over a charcoal grill

name: Chettinad Pepper Crab
description: Mud crab from Pulicat, tossed with crushed black pepper, curry leaf and roasted kalpasi. Best eaten with the hands.
imageAlt: Three whole crabs on a dark green plate

name: Tandoori Broccoli
description: Charred in the tandoor. Hung-curd and aged cheddar marinade, toasted almond, a dusting of chaat masala.

name: Nadru Monji
description: Lotus stem from the Dal Lake in a crisp rice-flour batter. Walnut chutney, fresh mint.

name: Kingfish Rava Fry
description: Seer fish rubbed with kokum and Byadgi chilli, crusted in semolina, crisped in coconut oil. Lime on the side.

name: Kuzhi Paniyaram
description: Fermented rice and lentil dumplings. Crisp at the edge, soft at the heart. Tomato thokku, coconut chutney.

name: Awadhi Nihari
description: Lamb shank slow-cooked for twelve hours. Bone-marrow jus, fried shallot, a thread of fresh ginger.
imageAlt: A slow-braised lamb shank in a dark bowl with roasted vegetables

name: Kashmiri Rogan Josh
description: Kid goat braised in Kashmiri chilli and ratan jot. Deep red, gently warm, finished with fennel and dry ginger.
imageAlt: A deep red lamb curry in a clay bowl, seen from above

name: Konkan Prawn Curry
description: Tiger prawns in a coconut and teppal masala, soured with kokum. Served with hand-pounded red rice.
imageAlt: Tiger prawns in a creamy coconut curry, topped with chilli threads

name: Gucchi Pulao
description: Wild morels from the Himalayan foothills, aged basmati, saffron and ghee. Cooked dum under a sealed lid.
imageAlt: A spoonful of saffron rice lifted from a dark pan

name: Paneer Lababdar
description: House-pressed paneer in a slow-reduced tomato and cashew gravy. Finished with cream and kasuri methi.

name: Chettinad Kozhi Curry
description: Country chicken in a masala of twenty-one roasted spices, ground on stone. Star anise, marathi mogga, curry leaf.

name: Bharli Vangi
description: Baby aubergines stuffed with roasted peanut, coconut and goda masala. Braised until they give at a touch.

name: Dum Pukht Biryani
description: Lamb and aged basmati layered with saffron, rose and kewra. Sealed in dough and slow-cooked in its own steam.

name: Sheermal
description: Saffron and milk flatbread, faintly sweet, baked against the wall of the tandoor.

name: Brown Butter Kulcha
description: Leavened overnight. Brushed with brown butter, scattered with nigella seed.

name: Kerala-style Appam
description: Lace-edged rice and coconut hoppers, fermented overnight. Soft and pillowed at the centre.

name: Kashmiri Girda
description: The Srinagar baker’s morning bread. Finger-dimpled, sesame-topped, from the wood-fired oven.

name: Saffron Kulfi
description: Milk reduced for six hours. Kashmiri saffron, slivered pistachio. Set in clay.

name: Gulab Jamun Cheesecake
description: Baked cheesecake on a khoya crumb. Warm gulab jamun, rose syrup, a little gold leaf.

name: Filter Coffee Tiramisu
description: Savoiardi soaked in Kumbakonam degree coffee. Mascarpone, palm jaggery. A Madras morning, reconsidered.

name: Kashmiri Phirni
description: Ground rice set with cardamom and rose. Walnut praline, dried apricot.

name: Kokum & Coconut Sorbet
description: Tart kokum sorbet, coconut cream snow, toasted cashew. Bright and clean.

name: Saffron Old Fashioned
description: Single-barrel bourbon rested on Pampore saffron. Jaggery syrup, orange bitters. Stirred over one clear cube.

name: Kokum Spritz
description: Kokum shrub, prosecco, soda and a twist of lime. Tart, bright, coastal.

name: Curry Leaf Gimlet
description: Gin, curry-leaf cordial, a drop of black-pepper tincture, fresh lime. Served up.

name: Rooh Sour
description: Aged rum, rose, green cardamom and lemon under a soft aquafaba foam.

name: Feni & Tamarind Sour
description: Cashew feni, tamarind, palm jaggery and lime. Short and sharp.

name: Kahwa Tonic
description: Cold-brewed Kashmiri kahwa, green cardamom, almond and tonic. Alcohol-free.

name: Aam Panna Fizz
description: Charred raw mango, roasted cumin, black salt and soda. Alcohol-free.
